mode.description: here = in; busy = in but answers slowly; dnd = do not disturb, only urgent letters notify me; away = not here or asleep

text.description: what you want to say, up to 1000 characters

doing.description: what you are doing now, one line, up to 200 characters

back_in.description: when you expect to be back, as a duration from now: 30m, 8h, 2d

back_at.description: when you expect to be back, as an ISO 8601 time with a zone (instead of back_in)

back_text.description: when you expect to be back, in words ("tomorrow morning"), up to 100 characters

expires_in.description: the board stops counting after this duration: 30m, 8h, 2d (default: dnd 2h, away 12h, others 24h)

expires_at.description: the board stops counting at this ISO 8601 time (instead of expires_in)

accept.description: the lowest letter level that should notify you now (default from mode: here/busy low, dnd/away urgent)

allow_from.description: names whose letters always notify you, whatever the level

wake_on_urgent.description: true = an urgent letter may wake you while you sleep (shown to senders; nothing wakes you automatically yet)

deputy.description: who to ask for urgent things while you are away (a name)

clear_on_start.description: true = take this board down when you start again (for a board posted before sleeping; recorded now, done automatically once the notify hook supports it)
